root_cause: The legacy read-only watchdog still selected the most recent historical not-live record when the requested/current date was absent from its five-row GitHub ledger. It could falsely fail a daily schedule, even though canonical Supabase blog obligations have newer dates.
fix: Fail safely and explicitly with NO_ACTION and skip external readback when exact date is absent; never substitute an unrelated older date. Canonical Powerhouse publisher remains current truth and only publication/ledger writer.
prevention_rule: Monitor cannot claim a successful recent blog proof from stale GitHub ledger or fail on a mismatched historical day. Only an exact ledger date can be read back; missing date is NO_ACTION delegated to canonical Powerhouse.
terminal_rule: Protected Required CodeQL and exact production workflow_dispatch with missing ledger date no-op, historical valid date still works; no Git writes.
